summary: Preserves local snapshot audit semantics and explicit empty-snapshot failures for AFFiNE canvas writes.
reason: Local snapshot-file audit and integrity checks should stay offline and not require live workspace/doc flags. Live AFFiNE document loads can also return an empty snapshot, which must fail clearly before applying a Y.js update. Historical snapshot fetches need a bounded HTTP client.
